why: An investigation is a sequence. Cold, a single large transfer to an unfamiliar counterparty is not judgeable and the agent has to ask. Once the context comes back explaining it as a property sale, the same alert closes. If state does nothing, the second run asks again. Measured across vendors on 2026-08-13: this holds against claude-sonnet-5 and fails against both gemini-3.7-flash and llama-3.3-70b, which answer the primed arm exactly as they answer the cold one. The claim is that history changes the answer, and on those two models it does not -- so read a pass here as a statement about this model, not about stateful agents in general.
